map.退保比例和退保率是一回事吗？: Are surrender ratio and surrender rate the same?
map.不是。退保比例是准备金中实际返还给客户的比例（受最小现金价值监管约束），退保率是: No. Surrender ratio is the share of reserve actually returned to the customer (bound by minimum-cash-value regulation), while surrender rate is a business metric of surrendered policies over in-force policies; their denominators differ.
